en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who gathers wealth from other than Permissible means, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Cause him to be overcome by the construction, and the water, and the clay’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one earns an asset through unlawful means Allah overpowers him by means of building, water and clay.”’
